blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V145 renders shows the authored overskirt surface is smoother than the V144 cloth-baked surface, but its armature-only deformation still breaks the intended skirt silhouette. In crouch the front shell opens and exposes the shorts/upper thighs; in sit it forms stiff angular flaps around the knees, and in prone it lifts into a broad rigid sheet.

Neutral front/back views show a broad, nearly conical skirt with weakly readable panel pleats and an uneven hard hem transition; side views show the skirt depth and panel edges do not resolve into a controlled garment drape. The stronger hem-follow weights did not produce an acceptable continuous silhouette.
The abrupt horizontal shelf at the waist-to-hip join and angular triangular surface artifacts along the torso sides remain visible in neutral and posed views.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
